source: Copies of generated trial1 applications; original results preserved

documents.focus: 文書を開きメモを入力し、一覧へ戻って検索条件・選択・メモを保持する導線。関連文書から一覧への戻り方も含む。

application.focus: 申込情報を入力し、確認から模擬決済へ進み、確認へ戻って入力を保持する導線。実決済は禁止。

required_test: Fixed Chromium operations with corrected async/cancel checks; failures remain failures
candidate_contract: Scoped canonical Journey/Screen/action/transition assertions supplied to candidate; baseline receives same design JSON as repository context but has no --ux-contract feature
limits: At most one repair batch and independent re-review; no implicit retry or larger caps. This is a focused synthetic regression, not whole-app approval.
